The Setting

One Evening Beneath the Dome

The dinner unfolds beneath the iconic dome of Robuchon au Dôme — Macau’s only French restaurant to have retained three MICHELIN stars for 18 consecutive years, and a recipient of the Wine Spectator Grand Award every year since 2005.

Behind it sits Asia’s most extensive and exclusive collection of Old and New World wines: a staggering 17,800 labels and over 500,000 bottles.

3MICHELIN stars
18Consecutive years
17,800Wine labels
500,000+Bottles in the cellar

The Centrepiece

The Iconic 1947 Vintage

“The Wine of the Century.” A post-war miracle of richness and concentration, widely considered the greatest Bordeaux ever produced. Château Cheval Blanc · Saint-Émilion

The 1947 Cheval Blanc is considered a miraculous vintage — the greatest wine of the 20th century. It is both very powerful and extremely well-balanced.

Due to its high percentage of alcohol, combined with some residual sugar, many critics consider this wine totally extraordinary and unique in the world of wine.

Despite its age, it is still in spectacular form — utterly captivating, with a presence that feels both profound and effortless.

The Hosts

Insights from the Master

Two custodians of two great houses — one in the cellar, one in the kitchen — co-hosting a single evening.

President · Château Cheval Blanc & Château d’Yquem

Pierre Lurton

For over 200 years, generations of winegrowers have shaped the lands of Cheval Blanc. Workers, farmers, winemakers and cellar masters have all been united by a shared devotion to their craft. Since 1991, Pierre Lurton has guided Château Cheval Blanc with the precision of an orchestral conductor — overseeing the countless details that define the estate’s exacting standards and embody its enduring pursuit of excellence.

Widely recognised as one of France’s preeminent winemakers, he will share profound insights into an iconic lineup of Cheval Blanc wines, flawlessly paired with exquisite French gastronomy.

Three-MICHELIN-Starred Chef · Robuchon au Dôme

Julien Tongourian

An eight-course haute French menu, personally designed to bring out the character of each exceptional vintage. Chef Julien began his career in 1996 and worked with legendary Chef Joël Robuchon for more than 20 years. After leading esteemed kitchens in Paris and Hong Kong, he became Executive Chef of Robuchon au Dôme in 2015.

Under his leadership, the restaurant has consistently held Three MICHELIN Stars for 18 consecutive years.
